title: Enterprise Agent Machine Autofill Ingestion V1
description: Authenticated connector event that may only create or update an unconfirmed five-quantity review draft. Byte-size and cross-field identity checks are additionally enforced by the Agent.

draft_key.description: The operator identifier and month must exactly match the receiving one-mine Agent identity and normalized source content.

content.description: Non-empty valid UTF-8 source snapshot. The authoritative runtime limit is 2 MiB after UTF-8 encoding; JSON string escaping may make the outer HTTP body larger.

observed_at.description: Timezone-aware time when this exact upstream snapshot was successfully observed. The Agent independently bounds future timestamps and derives expiry from its own source policy.

coverage_as_of.description: Business-date coverage asserted by the deterministic connector. It is evidence metadata, not permission to invent missing values.

truth_statement.description: Acknowledges that the event is a source snapshot, not a regulatory conclusion. It does not raise trust level or waive human review.

trigger_workflow.description: Requests the deterministic data-readiness preflight after the connector has observed the configured source generation. It never triggers confirmation or submission.

workflow_name.description: Compatibility wire identifier. In V1 its only permitted execution is the five-quantity data-readiness preflight, not a health or regulatory determination.
